summary_en: Orchestra Holdings to acquire Sharing Innovations via simplified stock exchange (stock-for-stock merger), making Sharing Innovations a wholly-owned subsidiary effective 2026-11-30. Sharing Innovations shares to delist from TSE Growth on 2026-11-26 (last trading day 2026-11-25). Acquisition rationale: enable faster decision-making and unified deployment of group resources in DX services amid generative AI adoption and engineer hiring competition.
title_en: Notice of Execution of Stock Exchange Agreement for Complete Acquisition of Sharing Innovations Inc. by Orchestra Holdings Inc. (Simplified Stock Exchange)
translation_en_brief: Orchestra Holdings Inc. and Sharing Innovations Inc. announced execution of a stock exchange agreement on 2026-08-25, under which Orchestra Holdings will become the wholly-owning parent and Sharing Innovations will become a wholly-owned subsidiary via simplified stock exchange procedure. The transaction is scheduled to become effective on 2026-11-30, following approval by Sharing Innovations shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting planned for 2026-10-26. Orchestra Holdings does not require shareholder approval under the simplified procedure. Sharing Innovations shares will delist from the TSE Growth market on 2026-11-26 (final trading day 2026-11-25). The acquisition eliminates governance constraints that currently limit integrated resource deployment and inter-company transactions, enabling faster strategic decision-making. Stated benefits include stronger execution on large-scale projects through shared development and sales resources, improved quality and productivity via shared human capital and technical expertise, and cross-selling and new revenue creation via consolidated customer base. Sharing Innovations currently bears annual listing costs of 40–50 million yen and previously required board approval for transactions with group companies to ensure minority shareholder protections—constraints that will be eliminated upon full acquisition.
